controls.name: frozen-input-bindings
controls.oracle: Recheck root selection, proposal, admitted runner and complete pinned pack digests before any run; a mismatch prevents admission.

controls.name: missing-member
controls.oracle: Delete one required original, fixture or inventory in separate copies; each refuses before child compilation and records a failed receipt.

controls.name: extra-member
controls.oracle: Add an unlisted regular file, including a hidden file; exact closure refusal occurs before children.

controls.name: changed-member
controls.oracle: Change selected source, fixture and inventory bytes separately without changing the pinned runner; each hash/length mismatch fails.

controls.name: linked-members-and-ancestors
controls.oracle: Replace members and ancestors with owned symlinks, including internal targets; refuse rather than follow them.

controls.name: closed-canonical-paths
controls.oracle: Traversal, absolute/noncanonical paths, duplicate destinations, .git and nonregular members all fail; use only owned temporary filesystem objects.

controls.name: unmodified-source-pairs
controls.oracle: Every library/independent source copy equals selected original bytes; no appended test body or substituted source may count as unmodified evidence.

controls.name: exact-two-augmentations
controls.oracle: Derive both test-only files from original bytes plus exact frozen UTF-8 suffixes, compare complete hashes, and refuse prefix/suffix changes.

controls.name: closed-interface
controls.oracle: Arbitrary source, model, command, flags, filters, test options and unknown overrides are denied; no evaluation of model/provenance occurs.

controls.name: output-refusal
controls.oracle: Refuse existing outputs, destinations inside pack/historical packets, linked ancestors and noncanonical paths; permit a fresh owned external output.

controls.name: optimization-cannot-bypass
controls.oracle: Repeat decisive malformed-pack, inventory and negative-diagnostic refusals under python -O; failures remain failures without assert-dependent checks.

controls.name: fresh-selected-host-run
controls.oracle: After root admission, freshly compile exact library, producer and independent closure and obtain all required results in one invocation; historical success is never substituted.

controls.name: exact-listing
controls.oracle: Empty, missing, extra, duplicate and substituted names fail independently for 78/14 inventories; exit zero alone is insufficient.

controls.name: exact-execution
controls.oracle: Execution names and counts must match listings and fixed inventories; partial, repeated, ignored, measured, filtered, failed or successful-empty runs fail.

controls.name: complete-host-layouts
controls.oracle: Require every named layout and value, including Metadata 144 and Result 152; missing, duplicated, altered or wrong-host observations fail.

controls.name: positive-api-prerequisite
controls.oracle: The positive probe must compile first with the fresh unchanged library artifact; missing or failed positive/library never validates negatives.

controls.name: intended-json-api-diagnostics
controls.oracle: Require each frozen primary code, intended item/trait and selected probe source span; wrong span, child-only code, malformed JSON or wrong target fail.

controls.name: negative-false-positives
controls.oracle: Missing source/library, incompatible metadata, unexpected error codes, crash, signal, timeout, successful compile or produced executable never count as intended API refusal.

controls.name: compiler-identity-and-rustup-dispatch
controls.oracle: Preserve launcher, query --print sysroot in repository with RUSTUP_AUTO_INSTALL=0, directly use selected sysroot/bin/rustc, and reject rustup-init/manager-version success as compiler identity.

controls.name: missing-compiler-no-install
controls.oracle: Unavailable toolchain, spawn error, malformed sysroot or incomplete verbose identity fail with no install or fallback compiler substitution.

controls.name: explicit-and-PATH-selection
controls.oracle: Exercise explicit and PATH launchers, capture exact executable hashes/sysroot/host fields, and detect incorrect resolved-symlink dispatch.

controls.name: fixed-command-custody
controls.oracle: Commands are argument arrays with fixed cwd and scrubbed injection variables; caller Rust/test variables do not alter selected flags, filters, fixtures or scratch.

controls.name: serial-bounded-groups
controls.oracle: One synchronous owned group at a time; command caps 15/60/120 and active deadline 480 are enforced, followed by at most 60 seconds retention/cleanup.

controls.name: descendant-timeout-and-partial-logs
controls.oracle: A fixture child and descendant emit partial bytes then block; timeout preserves both streams, terminates only that group, reaps direct child and proves owned-group return before cleanup.

controls.name: spawn-failure-receipt
controls.oracle: Compiler/test spawn failures retain command, cwd, environment, timestamps, error and raw logs, with an unambiguously failed terminal receipt.

controls.name: interrupted-run-receipt
controls.oracle: Interrupt an owned run; retain partial bytes, stop/reap its group, bound cleanup and write failure without inspecting unrelated processes.

controls.name: scratch-ownership
controls.oracle: Record exclusive marker/device/inode; changed marker, replaced root or changed identity prevents deletion and leaves recoverable bytes.

controls.name: cleanup-links-and-special-files
controls.oracle: Links/special files discovered at cleanup fail closed; nothing outside the owned root is removed, and failure is not recorded as clean success.

controls.name: lossless-failure-retention
controls.oracle: Before deletion retain complete test input/report/failure bytes, including every independent actual-File report; losslessly decompress sparse fixture retention and verify original/compressed sizes and hashes.

controls.name: interrupted-retention-recoverability
controls.oracle: Stop retention midstream; scratch source survives until verified complete retention, with no false claim that incomplete compressed bytes are a complete artifact.

controls.name: products-and-source-snapshots
controls.oracle: Hash every compiler product before removal; preserve executed runner, selected source/derived snapshots, fixed inputs and exact command/log records.

controls.name: postflight-mutation
controls.oracle: Changes to pack, source snapshot, derived input, runner or compiler between preflight/postflight force final failure, including on already failed paths.

controls.name: failure-cannot-claim-pass
controls.oracle: Selection, identity, copy, compile, list, execute, API, postflight, retention and cleanup failures produce nonzero status and accurate receipt; no completed/success/cleanup claim survives an uncompleted phase.

controls.name: complete-receipt-and-artifacts
controls.oracle: Reconcile complete command records, raw hashes, named actual-File reports and retained file inventories with terminal receipt; detect omission, stale reuse, truncation or unowned/frozen-path output.

controls.name: scope-and-numeric-truth
controls.oracle: All outputs retain storedPrefixValidated/fullReplayAccepted/semanticMetricsValid false, fixed 534*S_paid+47*F_paid+425*N_B and W24/B471/G112/T42/F42/finish47; no native, semantic, release or GA authority is claimed.

controls.name: unchanged-framing-and-narrow-closure
controls.oracle: Existing framing44/workflow stay unchanged; exclude historical collectors/runners, model execution, interposition overlay execution, broad archives and engine/CLI/target integration.

controls.name: actual-environment-and-future-CI
controls.oracle: Record actual Python/compiler/OS/machine/revision/tree; local host results never claim remote CI, other compiler/host qualification or physical-device evidence.

controls.name: independent-review-method
controls.oracle: Run the real admitted runner as a black box with independently authored inputs; do not import candidate helpers, patch runner code or count candidate tests/static syntax as independent behavioral proof.

controls.name: preaccess-and-admission-order
controls.oracle: Freeze this plan before candidate access; begin future code review and actual host execution only after root admits the frozen pack and runner.

controls.name: bounded-handoff
controls.oracle: Preserve unsuccessful evidence and pending gates; report exact reviewed digests, independent outcomes and limitations for root acceptance without broad historical replay or full-repository testing.

future_execution_rule: Root must admit frozen runner and pack first; all controls are planned and none has passed by this preparation.
